description:
Welcome to The Music City!  From Nashville's earliest settlers to the Fisk Jubilee Singers, and still today, Nashville has been know as The Music City. Our condo is steps from Broadway, Bridgestone Arena, The Music City Center, and The Country Music Hall of Fame. All of downtown Nashville is at your doorstep. 

Enjoy views from the sky lounge, spend summer days by our resort-style pool, or kick back and enjoy beer & game night on the apartment patio & green space.
